config_panel.covers_low_mode_desc: Alternative entity or script used when a scenario action has mode "low" (e.g. a second, slower cover entity). The script receives the target position as variable "position".
config_panel.covers_contact_desc: Binary sensor or multi-state handle sensor. The picker suggests sensors, but any entity can be chosen — its state is only read and mapped below. Enables the contact condition and the safety rule.
config_panel.covers_contact_map_desc: Map each raw sensor state to closed / tilted / open. Prefilled for standard binary sensors.
config_panel.covers_contact_map_needs_entity: Pick a contact sensor first — its states fill this list.
config_panel.covers_safety_desc: With an open window, automatic closing below the ventilation position is prevented. This rule cannot be disabled, only configured.
config_panel.covers_safety_tilted: Also apply when the window is tilted
config_panel.scenarios_intro: Scenarios move covers at a trigger time when all conditions are met. Order defines priority when two scenarios collide on the same minute.
config_panel.scenarios_today_none: No occurrence today — the sun does not reach this position.
config_panel.scenarios_run_saved_hint: Runs the saved scenario — save your changes first.
config_panel.scenarios_only_if_desc: All conditions must be met at trigger time. Need OR? Create a second scenario with the same trigger.
config_panel.scenarios_period_hint: Outside these periods the scenario is not planned at all — “Run now” still works. Several periods add up (any of them is enough), both days of a period are included, and a start after the end runs across the turn of the year (e.g. 15 Oct – 31 Mar).
config_panel.scenarios_retry_hint: If conditions fail at trigger time, the scenario waits and re-checks whenever one of the failing entities changes — until the window ends. Cover position conditions never re-trigger this check.
config_panel.scenarios_position_hint: 0% = closed, 100% = open (Home Assistant convention). For awnings 100% = extended.
config_panel.scenarios_safety_override: If the window is open (safety rule)
config_panel.scenarios_safety_override_hint: What happens when a window contact blocks closing: keep the cover where it is, still close down to the ventilation position, or close fully anyway (ignore the window — e.g. at night). Empty = each cover's own safety setting. Adjustable per cover in the assignment details.
config_panel.scenarios_min_delta_hint: Skip the movement when the cover is already within this distance of the target. Empty = entry default.
config_panel.scenarios_no_covers_hint: Create covers first on the Covers tab.
config_panel.scenarios_extra_conditions_desc: Checked in addition to the scenario conditions (AND).
config_panel.trigger_sun_az_hint: Fires when the sun crosses this compass direction — only while the sun is above the horizon.
config_panel.trigger_facade_hint: Each cover fires when the sun crosses its own facade direction plus this angle (e.g. −45° = 45° before the sun is square on the window, +60° = 60° after). Only while the sun is above the horizon; covers without a facade direction are skipped.

config_panel.trigger_facade_no_covers: Assign covers below to see today's times.

config_panel.cond_type_entity_state_not: An entity does NOT have a state

config_panel.cond_sun_rel_generic: Uses each cover's own facade direction.
config_panel.log_intro: Recent actions: every execution, skip, wait and block with its reason.
config_panel.help_today_statuses_body: Planned: the trigger time is still ahead. Executed: the cover was moved. Skipped: conditions were not met or the move was unnecessary (see reason). Waiting: conditions failed at trigger time — the scenario keeps watching the failing entities until its re-arm window ends. Expired: the window ended without success. Blocked: the safety rule prevented closing because the window is open. Unavailable: a required entity was missing — for safety, nothing was moved.
config_panel.help_low_mode_title: What if no low-mode target is configured?
config_panel.help_low_mode_body: Low mode is an optional alternative drive path (e.g. a slower, quieter motor profile). If a scenario uses mode “Low” but this cover has neither a low-mode entity nor a script, the action simply runs on the normal cover entity — it never fails because of this. If both are configured, the script takes precedence and receives the target position as the variable “position”.
config_panel.help_contact_map_title: How does the state mapping work?
config_panel.help_contact_map_body: Internally the integration only knows closed / tilted / open. Every raw sensor state is translated through this table. Unmapped states count as “unknown”: contact conditions then fail and the safety rule stays inactive (fail-safe — never move “just in case”). For standard binary sensors, off → closed and on → open is prefilled.
config_panel.help_safety_title: When exactly does the safety rule kick in?
config_panel.help_safety_body: Only for automatic closing moves: if the contact reports open (or tilted, if enabled below) and the target position is below the ventilation position, the move is blocked — or clamped to the ventilation position, depending on the setting. Opening moves are never restricted, and manual control in Home Assistant is unaffected.
config_panel.help_priority_title: What does the list order do?
config_panel.help_priority_body: The order is the priority. If two scenarios target the same cover in the same minute, they execute top to bottom — the action executed last determines the final position. Such conflicts are also written to the Home Assistant log.
config_panel.help_random_title: How does the random window work?
config_panel.help_random_body: The offset is rolled once per day (seeded with date + scenario), so the planned time stays stable across restarts and is shown exactly in the Today tab. “later only” adds 0–X minutes, “earlier only” subtracts 0–X minutes, “both” varies within ±X minutes. Useful e.g. for presence simulation while away.
config_panel.help_retry_body: Trigger 13:00, condition “weather is sunny”, window 4 h: at 13:00 it is cloudy, so the assignment waits (status “Waiting”). The moment the weather helper switches to sunny — say 13:37 — the cover moves. Still cloudy at 17:00? The run expires and nothing happens. Every assignment executes at most once per day, so a flapping sensor can never cause ping-pong. Cover-position conditions never re-trigger this check — a manually moved cover stays untouched.
config_panel.help_mode_low_body: “Low” uses the cover's low/discreet drive path — the alternative entity or script configured on the cover (e.g. a slower, quieter run). Covers without a low-mode target simply execute the action normally; nothing fails or is skipped because of the mode.
config_panel.help_min_delta_body: If the cover is already within this distance of the target, the move is skipped (result “Skipped”, reason “already at …”). That protects the motors and avoids visible twitching, e.g. during the catch-up after a restart. A requested tilt change still executes.
config_panel.help_override_body: Empty fields inherit from the scenario's “Then” action; only filled fields deviate — for this one cover. Example: the scenario closes to 0 %, the bedroom override says 25 % — every other cover still moves to 0 %. The badge “Override” on the row shows that a deviation is active.
config_panel.help_assignments_body: Each row is one cover controlled by this scenario. A row without extra settings inherits everything — that is the normal case. Expand a row to add conditions that apply only to this cover (checked in addition to the scenario conditions, AND) or to override the action.
config_panel.cond_sum_safety: Window open — safety rule blocks closing below {ventilation}%
config_panel.cond_sum_safety_clamp: Window open — will only close down to the {ventilation}% ventilation position
config_panel.cond_sum_safety_ignore: Window open — override closes fully anyway
config_panel.today_plan_intro: Every scenario firing today with its covers and live status.
config_panel.covers_group_control: Control all covers in this room
config_panel.scenarios_order_desc: Order defines priority when two scenarios collide on the same minute. Drag to reorder.
config_panel.scenarios_run_ignore_help: Run the scenario now and skip the 'only if' checks - every assigned cover moves to its target regardless of the current state (for testing / preview). The safety rule still applies.
config_panel.help_conditions_scope_title: How are conditions checked with several covers?
config_panel.help_conditions_scope_body: Conditions are evaluated per cover, not per scenario. A window-contact or cover-position condition uses each cover's own sensor, so 'only if the contact is closed' skips just the covers whose window is open - the others still run. A condition on a shared entity (e.g. a weather helper) is the same for every cover, so it lets them all run or skips them all together.
config_panel.covers_azimuth_hint: Azimuth defines when the sun hits this window — used by sun-protection scenarios.
config_panel.reason_entity_unavailable: Entity {entity} was unavailable — nothing was moved for safety
config_panel.reason_trigger_passed: Trigger time had already passed (e.g. restart or recalculation after the planned time)
config_panel.reason_waiting_facade: Waiting until the sun reaches this facade
config_panel.reason_no_facade: No facade direction set for this cover
config_panel.reason_sun_not_reaching: The sun does not reach this facade today
config_panel.reason_already_at: Already at {pos}% — moves smaller than {delta}% are skipped to protect the motor

config_panel.reason_cover_off: Automation is switched off for this cover

config_panel.covers_manual_low_desc: The arrow buttons and the test slider drive the low-speed entity/script instead of the normal cover entity. Stop always uses the normal entity.
